searchText: So post 1559, It seems like some pools are always increasing block size, while other are always decreasing the block size. I'm not sure I understand each actors logic. Could some one point me in a direction for reading on the topic? 1559 was clearly not meant for a network at full capacity at all times. There's no one time spikes here, it's all spike L2's look great but they are not there yet and possibly won't be for months. We need more juice There are a few trade-offs involved in raising the gas limit. Have a look at this for some insight: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vJNO_UqcH6A Hi I had a question regarding legacy transactions using metamask. Say I’m using an older version of meta mask that does not include miner tip. The old version does not include a spot for miner tip so how is the miner tip included? Or does it default to a 1 gwei tip? Or is no tip included only the base fee? Sorry I’m new to all this so if there are any resources for this feel free to let me know <#692078615269212180> is a better place to discuss this, but the TL;DR is that legacy transactions pay any fee over the base fee to the miner. Ahh didn’t see that section sorry but thanks for the information This isn't the right place for memeing or complaining (I'm not sure which that screenshot falls under). Is there a future where billions of dollars of value could be trapped on L1 because base fee stays consistently high enough for it to not be worth extracting a small amount of staked assets from relatively inefficient contracts? Neither. Just off topic ... This channel is for R&D discussions that aren't covered by the existing topics. It isn't meant as a #random. <@!273808422753796097> has mentioned this issue in the past. Check here: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/some-medium-term-dust-cleanup-ideas/6287 lol of course he has, thanks need a #random channel from where people can be guided though :p We don't want people talking about random stuff in this server. There are plenty of places on the internet for that other than here. 😄 Will there be a post EIP-1559 review/comparison between expected and actual results? Would be very interesting to see if theory held up to reality. <#692078615269212180>. There was a call with integrators where Barnebe went over that, and will probably be another. Plus I think Barnebe is continuing to monitor and compare, Thanks for the direction I’ll go watch sometime 🙂
